title: Add attachment-stamped audit proxy and KMS constraint optimizer
author: Priya Iyer
release_notes: Introduces an attachment-stamped audit proxy to embed non-repudiable seals in audit envelopes and a KMS constraint optimizer that reduces cross-region KMS calls by coalescing candidate key selections.
description: Motivation: Customers operating in regulated zones requested stronger, append-only audit artifacts that carry compact, verifiable sealing information per request attachment (payloads, model outputs, and routing metadata). At the same time, repeated KMS selector calls across region boundaries were a measurable contributor to latency and billing spikes for multi-tenant workloads. This PR implements two coordinated features: 1) an attachment-stamped audit proxy that signs a compact attachment fingerprint using tenant-scoped KMS keys and emits a sealed audit envelope with provenance headers; 2) a KMS constraint optimizer service that pre-computes region-aware key candidate sets and caches selection decisions for short TTLs, falling back to strict validation when constraints change. Changes include server-side runtime hooks, a small client-side SDK helper for generating attachment fingerprints, policy updates for RBAC v2 to allow temporal sealer grants, and migration steps for audit ingesters. Scope: - runtime/service: new attachment sealer middleware and audit-envelope composer - kms service: constraint optimizer + metrics and decision cache - authz: RBAC v2 role template for 'sealer.grant' with timebound allowance - sdk: helper function in redwood-sdk-go and redwood-sdk-python to compute attachment stamps - infra: migration task that backfills audit index entries with new headers Backwards compatibility: Audit messages without attachment stamps are accepted; when stamped messages are present ingesters verify stamp signatures if the tenant flag is enabled. Rollout plan: 1) Feature flag off by default. 2) Canary deploy proxy in us-west-2 with a single high-volume tenant. 3) Monitor audit verification error rates and KMS constraint cache hit ratio. 4) Gradual enablement per-tenant via Console. Checklist: - [x] implement sealer middleware and envelope composer - [x] implement KMS constraint optimizer + decision cache - [x] SDK helpers for Go and Python (TS planned in follow-up) - [x] RBAC v2 role template and admission validator - [x] unit and integration tests for verification workflow - [x] add tracing and perf metrics for KMS selector path - [x] migration plan + one-time backfill script Links: Linear ENG-4021 (design), SEC-119 (threat-model); design doc: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-4021/attachment-stamped-audit-proxy; smoke dashboards: grafana/dashboard/attach-seal-canary.

review_comments: Diego Alvarez: This looks solid; two questions: (1) can you quantify the expected extra per-request latency for the sealing step? (2) what's the failure mode if KMS is not reachable?

Author (Priya): Latency: median +2.3ms when using cached decision; cold path +15-25ms depending on KMS provider. Failure mode: we emit an unsigned envelope with a 'seal-missing' header and the ingestion path treats it as non-stamped. The migration uses a strict-mode gate for tenants that require stamped artifacts.
Maya Chen: Concern about RBAC risk surface — granting sealer privileges could be abused for replay attacks. Suggest timebound + operator-approval required for long-lived grants.
Author: Added timebound TTL on sealer role and updated admission validator to require operator approval for >1h grants. Documented in templates and Console UX notes.

Luca Romano: KMS constraint optimizer uses Redis decision cache; ensure the eviction policy won't cause inconsistent key selections during operator scale-up. Also please add telemetry for cache eviction reasons.
Author: Added eviction_reason tag and a prewarming step during replica scale events. Added unit tests simulating eviction and forced re-election.
Diego Alvarez: CI flake on e2e-deploy — rerun fixed it. Approving now.
Maya Chen: LGTM after RBAC tweak and tests pass.
notes_on_migration: One-time backfill script must be run with read-only window for audit index. Migration script id: 2025_09_backfill_attachment_stamps.sql. Ops checklist added to the release playbook.
observability_and_alerts: New metrics: kms_constraint_cache.hit_ratio, attachment_seal.success_rate, attachment_seal.missing_rate, attachment_seal.sign_latency_p50/p95. Alert: attachment_seal.missing_rate > 0.5% for 10m in canary cluster triggers rollback. Added tracing span 'attachment.seal' and tag 'seal_source' (cache|cold|fallback).
